title: Admissible-modification closed-fibre limit-site data
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I$ an ideal. Use affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum], scheme base change [def-pc-base-change], affine blowups [def-nagata-affine-blowup], small etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and derived cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. A full-support centre is a finitely generated ideal $J$ with $V(J)=V(I)$. Let the modification category be the category induced in schemes over $\operatorname{Spec}A$ by $J\mapsto\operatorname{Bl}_J(A)$, and form its diagram of closed fibres over $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$. A site presentation of its topos projections consists of continuous functors from the closed-fibre small etale sites into a common small site, whose sheafified inverse images on sets preserve finite limits, with comparison isomorphisms for every domination. The comparisons satisfy the canonical pullback-pasting cocycle. The associated cone of geometric morphisms [def-trf-geometric-morphism] is a limit when every compatible cone has a lift and every compatible family of transformations between lifts lifts uniquely. A compatible geometric point of the presenting site is a point whose composite with every site projection is isomorphic to the fibre functor of a geometric small-etale point [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods], after the canonical universe lift. These are definitions of data and predicates, not an assertion that a limit presentation exists.
